response.overview: "The Great Awakening" is the third instalment of the 'Plandemic' series. This documentary experience assembles forbidden puzzle pieces to reveal the big picture of what's really happening in America and beyond. 'The Great Awakening' is intended to be a lighthouse to guide us out of the storm and into a brighter future.
response.tagline: Filmmaker Mikki Willis explores topics related to COVID-19, the World Economic Forum, and freedom of speech.
response.title: Plandemic 3 - The Great Awakening
